title: My availability
description: Share open times so clients can request your help.
newSlotHint: Choose one service and a time that works for you. Clients can request this opening from your profile.
categoryHint: Choose a service you are ready to offer.
timePolicy: Start at least {leadHours} h from now. Each opening can be up to {maxHours} h long.
pricingTypeHint: Use a fixed task price or an hourly rate.
priceHint: The task price in dollars, before the client's service fee.
rateHint: The rate per hour in dollars, before the client's service fee.
estimatedHoursHint: About how many hours you expect the task to take.
hoursCapHint: The most hours included in the request.
created: Your open time has been posted.
emptyBody: Add an opening above so clients can find a time to request your help.
emptySetupBody: Verify your home address to post open times for clients to request.
atLimit: You have {count} open times. Cancel one to add another.
setupTitle: Verify your home address to post open times
setupBody: Open times go up as soon as your home address is verified, so clients can request them.
cancelBody: This opening will be removed from your profile. You can post another time later.
cancelHeldBody: {name}'s request will be declined and the hold on their card will be released. This opening will be removed from your profile.
canceled: Your open time has been canceled.

errors.createNotAllowed: You can't post this opening right now. Check that your home address is verified and try again.
errors.cancelNotAllowed: This opening can no longer be canceled here. Refresh to see its latest status.
errors.category: Choose one of your available services.
errors.date: Choose a date within the allowed range.
errors.startTime: Choose a later start that does not overlap another opening.
errors.endTime: Choose an end after the start, no more than {maxHours} h later.

previews.cancel-error: An opening could not be canceled
previews.slotList: Open times on a helper profile
